title: CacheWise: Understanding Workloads and Optimizing KVCache Management for Efficiently Serving LLM Coding Agents
authors: Shubham Tiwari; Tapan Chugh; Nash Rickert; Simon Peter; Ratul Mahajan; Haiying Shen
affiliations: University of Washington, University of Virginia
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Multi-tenant scheduling, KV cache offloading

problem_statement.en: Long-running coding-agent sessions repeatedly extend large prefixes across variable tool gaps, creating sustained KV pressure that FCFS scheduling and LRU eviction cannot manage using request recency alone.
problem_statement.zh: 長時間 coding-agent session 在變動的 tool gap 之間反覆延伸大型 prefix，形成持續 KV 壓力；FCFS scheduling 與 LRU eviction 僅憑 request recency 無法有效管理。

key_innovation.en: CacheWise combines prefix-aware request scheduling with reuse-aware block eviction predicted from tool name, arguments, and timing history, using lightweight clustering and trace-trained estimators without modifying coding agents.
key_innovation.zh: CacheWise 結合 prefix-aware request scheduling 與 reuse-aware block eviction，利用 tool name、argument 與 timing history，透過輕量 clustering 與 trace-trained estimator 預測重用，且無需修改 coding agent。

baselines_compared: vLLM, Prefix-aware scheduling, LRU, Ground-truth reuse predictor

key_improvements.en: At high load, 2.7-3.5x lower session completion time, 1.64-2x token goodput, 1.5-2x requests/s, and 2-2.6x fewer evictions/transfers.
key_improvements.zh: 高負載下 session completion time 降低 2.7–3.5x、token goodput 提升 1.64–2x、requests/s 提升 1.5–2x、eviction/transfer 降低 2–2.6x。

infra_layer: KV-cache reuse, Serving / scheduling, Workload characterization, State fabric / offload

workloads_traces.en: CATraces, approximately 10M tokens from real Claude Code sessions with messages, tool calls/results, token counts, timestamps, and human interventions; deterministic replay of concurrent independent sessions under increasing load.
workloads_traces.zh: CATraces，約 10M tokens 的真實 Claude Code sessions，包含 message、tool call/result、token count、timestamp 與 human intervention；在遞增 load 下確定性重播多個並發且獨立的 sessions。

key_parameters.en: Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct TP=2 on 2x H200, 282 GB combined, AMD EPYC 9534; vLLM with chunked prefill, maximum 512 tokens/chunk; KMeans over TF-IDF tool arguments, maximum 5,000 lexicons and 20/50/100-cluster variants; tool P50/P90/P99: python -c .1/.2/.4 s (n=9), mypy 10/56/182 s (46), docker compose 22/89/152 s (30), git add/status .1/34/97 s (34); exact examples include ls 49 ms, pytest 83,333 ms, WebFetch 39,988 ms. Engine version, session counts/load points, token lengths, cache budget, repeat count, train fraction, and heap-rebuild interval not stated.
key_parameters.zh: Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct、TP=2、2x H200，合計 282 GB，AMD EPYC 9534；vLLM 啟用 chunked prefill，maximum 512 tokens/chunk；對 TF-IDF tool argument 進行 KMeans，maximum 5,000 lexicons，並評測 20/50/100-cluster variants；tool P50/P90/P99：python -c .1/.2/.4 s（n=9）、mypy 10/56/182 s（46）、docker compose 22/89/152 s（30）、git add/status .1/34/97 s（34）；精確範例含 ls 49 ms、pytest 83,333 ms、WebFetch 39,988 ms。engine version、session count/load point、token 長度、cache budget、重複次數、train fraction 與 heap-rebuild interval 未載明。

metrics_defined.en: Token goodput is new/useful tokens per unit time; also requests/s, request completion, session completion as summed LLM request latency excluding tool duration, and KV transfer volume.
metrics_defined.zh: Token goodput 為每單位時間的新／有效 tokens；另含 requests/s、request completion、session completion（排除工具時間後的 LLM request latency 總和）與 KV transfer volume。

headline_vs_realistic.en: At high load, session completion is 2.7-3.5x lower and token goodput 1.64-2x higher; with physical CPU offload, the end-to-end gain over vLLM is only about 1.19x, while prediction alone gives 1.2-1.6x goodput.
headline_vs_realistic.zh: 高負載下 session completion 降低 2.7–3.5x、token goodput 提升 1.64–2x；採 physical CPU offload 時，相較 vLLM 的端到端增益僅約 1.19x，而單獨 prediction 的 goodput 為 1.2–1.6x。

key_assumption_dynamic.en: CacheWise assumes tool name, arguments, and elapsed history predict time to the next reuse; novel tools or per-query control changes weaken the predictor but retain reactive prefix scheduling.
key_assumption_dynamic.zh: CacheWise 假設 tool name、argument 與 elapsed history 可預測下一次重用時間；新工具或逐 query control change 會削弱 predictor，但仍保留 reactive prefix scheduling。
